pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:125 The effect authoring form has no tick-period field (only durationSec and cooldownSec), so DoT and tick templates carry their tick rate in cooldownSec, which codegen deliberately emits as an ability cooldown and never as a Period. A 'DoT' therefore generates as one non-ticking application, with no declared period and no derivable total intake.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:125 The time kinds are not typed: tick period is missing, and cooldownSec stands in for it on GE_Ignite_DoT, GE_DrainBeam_Tick (line 164) and GE_ManaDrain_PerSec. codegen.ts:126 refuses to emit Period, so the stream becomes a single hit.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/template-base.ts:53 State.Dead is a template-level activation block over Ability.*, alongside State.Stunned (line 54).

pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-math.ts:33 The shared dodge model scores the active defence as one ungraded i-frame window whose magnitudes (i-frame length, cooldown, stamina) are authored constants with no stat hook. That collapses the defence to the trigger axis: no tight-window grade and no build-scaled magnitude.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_combat/_shared/dodge-math.ts:33 Single binary window, no perfect or normal grade, and DodgeParams has no stat-scaled magnitude. A repo-wide grep found no perfectDodge or stat-scaling of the dodge.
